messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Neon Pairs is implemented, including all supported board sizes, reproducible board codes, snapshot import/export, saved preferences and best scores, and the replay CLI. The code follows the documented separation between game rules, browser session behavior, board, and controls.

**Offline build:** [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) — 238,616 bytes, with no external asset references. It was opened directly from disk with HTTP and HTTPS requests blocked.

**Verification passed:** locked install, type check, 13 unit tests, 4 browser journeys, and a fresh build. Tested with Node 26.12.1, npm 11.20.0, Playwright 1.64.1, and Chromium 156.0.8078.4. The journeys include accessibility-tree assertions; a screen reader was not used, as recorded in the [README](/work/README.md).
